approvalScope: Independent read-only review of the private supported-environment orchestrator, capture helper, setup source and bound preparation metadata. This does not approve any browser QA verdict, telemetry policy classification or overall task acceptance.

pinnedScopes.note: These exact fingerprints are required by every source capture and continuity guard; this review inspected the guard and prior frozen evidence, and directly rehashed current QA files only.

guardsReviewed: Exact 14-check by 2-base plan, one ordinary node tools/qa/run.mjs CHECK --base BASE invocation at a time, no retries, wrappers, native predicate edits, forced clicks or timeout changes.

Actual Popen argv/PID/spawn/wait/exit and own log, unique new raw directory with actual PID and native timestamp, exact summary/check copies, complete raw assertions/skips/observations/runner flags retained.

Per-use capture-helper hashes before and after capture, pinned five QA sources and entrypoint plus product/protected fingerprints, exact actual Playwright/core 1.64 identities and matching bundled Chromium binary/manifest, no fallback.

Requested and inspected actual SwiftShader mode, available WebGL and SwiftShader renderer required; genuine native assertion failures continue honestly, while setup/source/resource integrity failures stop further launches.

No next child before native closure: live Chromium/WebKit/runtime/preview processes rejected and all owned localhost preview ports must return ECONNREFUSED. Postsource follows child close; master continuity checked again at end.

SIGINT and SIGTERM enter own-child bounded native signal cleanup, retain actual child exit/wait/log and any own partial raw copies; interrupted or missing reports stay integrity failures and cannot become successful records.
Output resolved and required to be a new directory under /tmp, including symlink-escape rejection. Original repository/source/raw canonical files are not edited by the private source.

WebKit-only child LD prefix and exact final setup manifest binding; unchanged ordinary initial Chromium probe in that child honestly inherits the prefix. Other invocations retain original LD environment. Setup hash checked around each case/final capture.

Setup adds only approved local ELF/SONAME links in bundled WebKit sys/lib, refuses unproven existing destinations and overwrite, verifies package-extracted bytes and prefix confinement, preserves original wrapper/binary/engine/stock identities; final transitive extension is tied to the original retained baseline.
allSelectedRecordsVerified explicitly means native raw/CLI/source/driver/browser/closure verification only: no generic event policy, old 1.57 replacement, failure waiver or overall task acceptance.
limits: No orchestrator/helper/setup import or execution, browser launch, test execution, PNG work, repository or product source edits were performed by this reviewer.

Source approval cannot prove successful WebKit launch, all28 native QA results, telemetry-policy acceptance, or final task completion; those require actual bound reports and independent evidence review.
The supported 1.64 verification is a separate environment run; original 1.57 failed full runs and paired cold performance evidence remain unchanged.
Native declared-unavailable and feature-gap records must remain visible and cannot be described as full unconditional coverage.
